purpose: Freeze every development directed traversal, five-frame sample, objective structural-event identity, deterministic association pair and deduplicated storage estimate before sensor export or training.

approval.scope: One immutable CPU/Open3D manifest audit over the exact 80 train and 10 validation parents. Zero C10/M-TARE read, sensor export, model inference, training, optimizer, threshold selection or checkpoint operation.
approval.confirmation_reference: User granted continuing authorization for the fixed GSE-Graph paper plan without repeated approval requests.

sampling.short_traversal_rule: Retain traversal identity but store zero frames when no complete five-frame history exists.
sampling.trajectory_rule: Every physical edge is preserved independently in both directions; no event/outcome sampling or edge collapse.

teacher.source: sealed TNG + spline + native perception mesh
teacher.node_events: junction and terminal use parent-scoped TNG node identity
teacher.edge_events: turn and mesh geometry-transition samples from opposite traversals are clustered in canonical physical-edge arc with maximum adjacent gap 2.0 m
teacher.corridor: retains an event label but has no structural-node association identity
teacher.geometry_signature: dimensionless finite [width/(2*30m), height/(2*30m), abs(slope)/90deg, curvature/pi, width-height-valid-bit]; invalid width/height remain zero only inside the signature and are distinguished by valid-bit, while regression targets stay masked
teacher.positive_pair: same objective identity, preferring a different traversal
teacher.hard_negative: one deterministic closest different identity with the same event inside the same parent
teacher.student_input_exclusion: TNG identity, future frames, mesh and association labels never enter student input

storage.frame_layout: each unique 16x720 float32 range and uint8 valid mask stored once

leakage_audit.validation_role: manifest and later validation-only calibration; never training

expected_evidence: 18132-row traversal JSONL with offsets/counts and two zero-sequence identities retained
212588-row teacher observation JSONL with event, objective identity, geometry mask and global five-frame references
deterministic association-pair JSONL, edge-event identities, 90 world summaries and pair/identity counts
exact resource JSON, environment, source hashes before/after, raw log, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal
failure_policy: Fail on any source/tool/count/identity/pair/reference drift, duplicate pair, cross-parent/event pair, forbidden read, timeout or disk overrun. Do not change worlds, histories, teachers, pair rule or thresholds after observing output.
